summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Beatrice Heuser, an historian and political scientist. It gives her birth date and place and states that she holds the chair of International Relations at the University of Glasgow.
one_line: Biographical note on Beatrice Heuser, historian and political scientist who holds the International Relations chair at the University of Glasgow.
key_facts: Beatrice Heuser was born on 15 March 1961.
Beatrice Heuser was born in Bangkok.
Beatrice Heuser is an historian and political scientist.
Beatrice Heuser holds the chair of International Relations at the University of Glasgow.
